program='''def transform(grid):
    colors = sorted({value for row in grid for value in row})
    if len(colors) == 1:
        return [[0 for value in row] for row in grid]
    low, high = colors[0], colors[-1]
    return [[0 if value == low else low if value == high else value for value in row] for row in grid]
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
exec(compile(program, str(p), 'exec'), globals())
